lots.guide_summary: All SOLD, no unsold or asking evidence. Gowans boxes of 6 Pops made $15 to $40 hammer (2025-12 to 2026-10), 7-pop boxes $20 to $60. These exact six figures, boxed, sold on eBay US (PriceCharting) for a combined US$40.50 (A$58) using the lowest of the five latest sales each, or US$77.46 (A$111) using PriceCharting's current boxed average (Furiosa 8.50, Deadpool Blue 12.49, Ickis 19.24, Sora flocked 8.82, Dark Phoenix 13.41, Firestorm GITD 15.00). Rate USD 1 = AUD 1.4331 (frankfurter, 13 Oct 2026).
lots.working: Keep: lowest same-item SOLD total = sum of the lowest of the five latest boxed sales per figure on PriceCharting, US$0.99 + 7.00 + 15.00 + 2.25 + 9.00 + 6.26 = US$40.50 x 1.4331 = A$58.04; / 1.198 = 48.4, round down to $45. Note this is above most local Gowans 6-box hammers ($15 to $40), so in practice you rarely need to go that high. Flip: likely resale as one lot on Facebook Marketplace about A$50 (top of local 6-box results, lifted slightly for the Ickis convention exclusive), no selling fee and buyer collects, so 50 / 2.396 = 20.9, round down to $20. Selling singly on eBay: A$111 average less 13% fees (A$14.40) and A$2 packing each (A$12) = A$84.60 / 2.396 = 35.3, but that relies on US-level demand and six separate sales, so the lower lot figure is used. Pickup Moonah, inbound freight $0.
lots.confidence_reason: Every box label and sticker read in the photo, and each figure has opened PriceCharting sold data, but these are aggregated US eBay sales of single figures, not a sale of this lot, and box condition is only seen from the front.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped: lot 438132 $110 BOX OF ASST POP VINYLS and lot 411030 $210 QTY OF ASST POP VINYLS (count and contents unknown, not comparable to six named figures). Dropped the 2026-01-19 QTY OF ASST POP VINYLS entry: the researcher said $65 to $75, but the lots were 384168 $75, 384173 $55, 384182 $65, 384199 $75, and quantity is unknown, so not comparable. Corrected the 2026-05-31 entry (only three 7-pop lots plus one 6-pop lot exist; there was no fifth $55 sale). All Gowans prices re-checked in the API and match otherwise.

Stickers read: Ickis 'Funko Fall Convention Exclusive', Sora 'Flocked', Firestorm 'Glows in the Dark'. No sticker on Deadpool front, so it is priced as the plain blue X-Men Deadpool. Furiosa and Dark Phoenix are the common versions, not chase.

lots.question_for_gowans: Can you check the backs and tops of the boxes for crushing or tears, and whether the Deadpool box has an Underground Toys exclusive sticker on any side?
